notes_for_editor: Mostly two derivative sources (Lighthouse Friends, which paraphrases the Newfoundland Board of Works reports, and the town heritage statement). Disputes: Albert Jensen died 1907 per heritage statement vs keeper to at least 1912 per LHF. Owner: LHF says Canadian Coast Guard, record says Town of Harbour Breton. Tower height varies: 9.1 m (Register), 8.5 m (heritage statement), 7.6 m (List of Lights). Also, 'Jensen' keeper list from LHF lists Dave Drake 1960s-1995, omitted from story (post-1960). Unverified: Newfoundland annual reports not in corpus.
